scenes.headline: A 320B model on four mining cards
scenes.sub: The cheap cards are the headline. The work is an Ampere attention kernel.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Florin! People are running a giant model on cards built to mine crypto. The cards are the easy part.

scenes.text: GLM-5.3-Flash needs sparse-attention kernels that upstream only ships for Hopper. A fork writes them for the older Ampere cards.
scenes.mark: writes them for the older Ampere cards
scenes.say: This model's sparse attention only had kernels for the newest chips. A fork writes them for the older mining cards.

steps.say: A long prompt flows through the cheap linear layers first. They keep no cache.
Eleven layers run sparse attention. It keeps only the top keys, so a huge context stays cheap.
Those kernels only existed for the newest chips. The fork writes them for the older architecture.
Now it runs across four modified mining cards, sixty-four gigabytes each.

scenes.title: Two ways to cut it across four cards

left.title: Tensor-parallel
items: Each card holds part of every layer
Fastest for one user, 394 a second
left.say: Split every layer across the cards, and one user gets the fastest answer. But the cards talk constantly, so it needs a wide link.

right.title: Pipeline-parallel
items: Each card holds a quarter of the layers
Built for the stock narrow bus
right.say: Give each card a quarter of the layers, and they just pass activations. It reads prompts faster and fits the narrow bus.

scenes.title: The kernel upstream got wrong
scenes.say: Why a plain port is slow here.

items.say: Upstream sized blocks for sixty-four heads. Split four ways, each card has sixteen, so half the work was padding.
Clamp a bad key to row zero and let the mask erase it. A slow gather becomes a fast load.
About a third faster on long contexts. It loses on one short shape, and says so.

scenes.label: HumanEval, the author's own run
scenes.note: and 97.42% on GSM8K; reported, not re-run
scenes.say: A hundred sixty-two of a hundred sixty-four coding tasks, ninety-seven percent on math. One person's self-run; I didn't re-run these.

scenes.text: The model is not new and the cards are a shopping list. The method is the kernel someone wrote for Ampere.
scenes.mark: the kernel someone wrote for Ampere

recap: Sparse attention needed kernels Ampere never had
A fork wrote the sm_80 path, and sized it right
Numbers are one person's, not re-run
scenes.say: To recap: sparse attention with no kernel for these cards, a fork that writes one, and numbers that are one person's.
